profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
Highly versatile Senior Software Developer and Digital Strategist with 15+ years of experience bridging creative vision, enterprise-level Full-Stack Development, and data-driven marketing strategy. Expertise includes Agile/Waterfall project execution, MVC Architecture, RESTful API development, and database connectivity. Proven leader in translating complex business goals into scalable, secure, and performant web applications while maximizing Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and enforcing rigorous Quality Assurance (QA) across all digital platforms.

Expertly navigate diverse enterprise ecosystems, including LAMP/LEMP stacks for Drupal and WordPress and Java-based infrastructures for Cascade CMS. I specialize in decoupled (headless) architectures that leverage PHP (8.x), RESTful APIs, and SQL for robust backends, while utilizing React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS to build high-performance, SEO-optimized frontends. My technical breadth extends to managing scalable cloud deployments via AWS (Amazon Web Services) and maintaining rigorous security hardening standards across all digital platforms.

A specialist in architecting custom middleware and high-fidelity lead-capture solutions that bridge critical gaps within enterprise CMS and CRM ecosystems. I excel at overcoming 'out-of-the-box' platform limitations, recently exemplified by my custom engineering of the Halda AI lead-capture tool. By thinking beyond the tool’s native constraints, I transformed a standard site-wide search into a seamless, dual-purpose AI Career Outcomes Consultant, integrating it directly into the user experience to provide personalized value while simultaneously capturing high-intent data. My approach prioritizes system baseline stability and data integrity, ensuring that complex, multi-brand digital environments remain scalable, secure, and optimized for maximum conversion. By building these resilient 'revenue pipes' through custom CRM injections, I transform legacy technical debt into high-performance, AI-driven marketing engines.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer (React/Node.js)
positions.description:
Architect and maintain a high-performance Trading Partner Portal using React and Node.js, bridging modern web interfaces with legacy enterprise systems including AS/400 (ERP), MS SQL Server, and internal Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).

Develop and optimize specialized modules to streamline operations for Third-Party Logistics (3PL) and un-owned inventory accounts, providing partners with real-time visibility into complex supply chain data.

Engineer end-to-end features for billing and financial transparency, enabling partners to manage rate cards and conduct billing processes directly within the web application.

Build and scale a robust reporting engine that delivers prefabricated operational insights and supports custom reporting requests, translating raw SQL and ERP data into actionable business intelligence.

Collaborate cross-functionally with IT and Marketing teams to ensure the portal meets both technical scalability requirements and user-centric design standards.

Integrate disparate data sources by leveraging Node.js middleware to create efficient APIs that interface with the AS/400 ERP, ensuring data integrity and low-latency performance.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Node.js · IBM iSeries · IBM Mainframe · HighJump

positions.title: Digital Marketing and Web Manager
positions.description:
Engineered the multi-generational evolution of the College of Professional Studies ecosystem (ProfessionalStudies.DU.edu), managing high-stakes migrations from legacy ColdFusion to a decoupled Headless WordPress (Next.js/React) architecture, and finally to a high-performance WP Engine environment

Acted as Lead Developer and Project Manager for the full-scale strategic rebranding and domain migration of the college’s digital identity, successfully transitioning the UniversityCollege.DU.edu web property to the new ProfessionalStudies.DU.edu domain while maintaining 99.9% uptime. Orchestrated a comprehensive review and overhaul of all digital advertising assets, ensuring brand alignment and performance optimization across social, display, paid search, and website content.

Orchestrated cross-functional paid marketing strategies across Google Ads (including custom tailoring of Demand Gen and Performance Max campaigns), Microsoft Advertising (formerly Bing), LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, and Programmatic Display (The Trade Desk), personally engineering and implementing custom Meta Conversions API (CAPI) integrations to bypass browser signal loss and cookie depreciation. By integrating these technical solutions with CRM systems to ensure data-driven attribution, I drove a 10% increase in digital revenue and a 3x ROAS through optimized full-funnel guest acquisition and retention campaigns.

Architected and implemented a custom integration of the Halda AI lead-capture tool, engineering a dual-purpose AI Career Outcomes Consultant and site-wide search engine. By bypassing native tool limitations with custom JavaScript, I created a seamless user experience that captures high-intent prospective student data while providing personalized value-add insights.

positions.title: Website and CRM Developer
positions.description:
Directed the secure development and optimization of Regis.edu, leveraging PHP, React, and Java for enterprise Cascade CMS integrations. Engineered custom JavaScript and jQuery programs to extend native CMS capabilities, delivering interactive user experiences and high-performance front-end functionalities while ensuring 99.9% uptime and WCAG 2.1/2.2 compliance.

Served as Lead Developer and Data Strategist for the migration from legacy Ellucian Banner to Salesforce/Pardot. Engineered custom middleware and integration scripts to facilitate data flow where native CMS connectors were insufficient, ensuring schema integrity across disparate systems.

Overcame Cascade CMS architectural limitations by architecting "juggernaut" web forms with complex dependent field logic and custom validation. These forms were engineered to maintain CMS baseline stability while ensuring high-fidelity data capture for direct CRM injection.

Developed and maintained custom scripts linking Eloqua with Ellucian Banner; engineered automated data synchronization to ensure real-time accuracy across student recruitment and lifecycle engagement funnels.

Designed and hand-coded custom dynamic email templates using conditional logic to deliver hyper-personalized messaging; managed automated drip campaigns that significantly enhanced lead-to-enrollment conversion.

Managed and customized PHP-based CMS platforms (WordPress/Drupal), executing backend security hardening and AWS cloud deployments to support thousands of concurrent users.

positions.title: Ecommerce Developer
positions.description:
Architected and maintained the full-stack environment for a high-volume public-facing e-commerce platform. Developed custom website page templates and refined critical gaps in the user experience to streamline the path-to-purchase and reduce cart abandonment.

Engineered and maintained mission-critical data pipelines that synchronized real-time inventory levels and product availability across the web storefront; ensured data integrity between the backend database and front-end UI to prevent customer friction.

Directed development efforts toward SEO analytics and CRO strategies, implementing technical performance optimizations that enhanced search visibility and transactional throughput.

Engineered scalable layout templates for both digital and print mediums using the Adobe Creative Suite, ensuring brand consistency across the e-commerce ecosystem and marketing collateral.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Search Engine Marketing (SEM) · Social Media Marketing · Commercial Photography · E-Commerce · E-commerce SEO · E-commerce Optimization · Web Design

positions.title: Ecommerce Developer
positions.description:
Orchestrated the strategic shift from a traditional B2B model—historically reliant on print buyer catalogs—to a robust B2C e-commerce engine for flagship brands CinchJeans.com and CruelDenim.com.

Authored the organization’s first-ever Brand Standards Guide, modernizing dated legacy identities for digital scalability. Re-engineered complex logos into high-contrast, single-color versions and curated a new typography system utilizing web-safe font pairings to ensure visual consistency between digital platforms and physical print collateral.

Developed and launched the company’s inaugural direct-to-consumer web platforms using WordPress; applied full-stack engineering and secure development practices to support high-volume retail transactions and visual merchandising.

Engineered the organization’s first-ever SEO strategy and Google Ads (SEM) placements in collaboration with AdVision (Denver-based inbound agency); successfully established digital search authority for flagship brands and drove initial customer acquisition for the new B2C channel.

Designed and deployed end-to-end email marketing campaigns using HubSpot; engineered seamless data synchronization between front-end customer actions and the CRM to establish a foundation for automated guest retention and lifecycle engagement.
positions.insights: Skills: Website Building · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Email Marketing · Social Media Communications · Website Updating · Commercial Photography · Branding & Identity · Search Engine Marketing (SEM) · E-Commerce · B2B Marketing · B2C Marketing · Inbound Marketing

positions.title: Digital Marketing Assistant
positions.description:
Re-engineered the group’s email marketing strategy by transitioning from image-heavy, "spam-trigger" designs to semantically enhanced HTML5/CSS templates. This technical overhaul, combined with a rigorous audit of CAN-SPAM Act compliance (headers, opt-out logic, and physical addressing), increased open rates from 0.7% to 4.6%.

Directed email deployments within DealerSpeed (Automotive CRM); overcame platform limitations by custom-porting and hand-coding Mailchimp templates into the DealerSpeed environment to deliver the first stylized, brand-aligned campaigns in the company's history.

Designed and deployed high-performance online display advertising and managed a dual-stream lead funnel, coordinating campaign lists derived from both purchased data and organic website inquiries.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Generated high-impact imagery for diverse physical and digital assets, including large-format signage, vehicle wraps, merchandising displays, and national trade show exhibits such as the Denver Auto Show.

Directed daily operations and personnel for the in-house print shop, optimizing machine uptime and project coordination for large-format printers and vinyl cutters to meet high-volume deliverables.

Acted as a key consultant to the management team on the layout and configuration of outdoor merchandising displays and high-visibility presentations for in-house dealership events.

Managed the print shop budget and hardware maintenance, tracking monthly allocations and orchestrating weekly inventory procurement for materials and supplies to ensure fiscal accountability.

Managed the end-to-end procurement and contracting of specialized photographers, videographers, and creative talent for large-scale marketing initiatives.
